attr.title: Starship
attr.desc: Starship is the HarbourMasters PC port of Star Fox 64, built from the decompilation, with enhancements such as higher frame rates, widescreen support and mod support.
attr.inst: Copy your Star Fox 64 US v1.0 or v1.1 .z64 rom to ports/starship/baseroms. JP, EU and CN roms are optional and add voice packs. The rom is converted to sf64.o2r on first launch, which can take a few minutes.
